placement: Affinity plus descent64, fixed before priority prediction and charged to every arm
teacher: Best final objective among srpt:128, spt:8192 and srpt:8192; feasible, not globally optimal
target: Teacher priority rank normalized to [0,1], SmoothL1 over all 48 operations
architecture: Two typed residual layers, hidden16 and scalar priority head; MP-OFF separately trained; hand arm receives fixed typed one/two-hop means
training: AdamW lr0.001, batch16, 40 epochs, three seeds per arm; select minimum validation mean directly served objective including epoch0; no sweep
validation_bar: At least 5 percent mean gain over frozen srpt:128 and full p95 <=5ms for every selected GNN draw
live_gate: 32 sealed workflows times nine models, srpt:128, teacher and plain srpt =384 actual HeROsim runs; all operation completions checked against independent SimPy
claim_bar: GNN median paired gain >=5 percent against MP-OFF, hand-graph MLP and srpt:128, positive bootstrap lower bounds, all GNN draws <=5ms p95
logging: Offline Weights and Biases, CPU only, retained checkpoints and contracts
scope: Small fixed-placement priority pilot; no joint placement-order claim and no powered publication claim
